status: AI experimental adoption authorized by user; not independent scientific review
assumptions: Primary source table rows are provisional transcriptions, not new human-reviewed labels.
A unique PubChem name hit supplies only a provisional source-to-structure mapping; ambiguous hits remain excluded.
Unknown origin/activity never supplies a negative label.
No threshold or feature selection will use the experimental held-out scores.
Source-specific targets retain species, endpoint, dose basis, assessment time, controls and unresolved protocol issues.

EXPERIMENT-AMBROSIA2019-LETTUCE-1MM-7D-O.scope: Table 2 pure confertin and neoambrosin at 1000 micromolar; Lactuca sativa; seven-day ordinal germination/growth response
EXPERIMENT-AMBROSIA2019-LETTUCE-1MM-7D-O.controls: solvent wells; exact vehicle and replication not stated in inspected section 3.7.1
EXPERIMENT-AMBROSIA2019-LETTUCE-1MM-7D-O.selection: retrospective assay-rule proposal; not preregistered before literature inspection

EXPERIMENT-NONENOLIDES2021-SONCHUS-2MGML.scope: Table 2, source compounds 1-11; punctured Sonchus arvensis leaf discs; 10 microliters of 2 mg/mL; 120-hour necrotic lesion diameter
EXPERIMENT-NONENOLIDES2021-SONCHUS-2MGML.controls: 5% ethanol vehicle; twelve discs per treatment; no equivalence inference
EXPERIMENT-NONENOLIDES2021-SONCHUS-2MGML.selection: retrospective descriptive threshold; no transfer to lettuce or intact-leaf efficacy

pooled_sensitivity.target: source-specific high versus low response under the parent policy; not a common biological activity estimand
pooled_sensitivity.purpose: measure computational feasibility and publication/assay confounding under intentionally permissive experimental pooling
pooled_sensitivity.limitations: Different species/stages/doses/endpoints/time; not an accepted activity model or evidence of safer herbicides.
pooled_sensitivity.validation: Keep five-fold scaffold gates and fixed seed; no random-split rescue or threshold search. Also test publication transfer when both train and test classes exist.
pooled_sensitivity.models: Fixed formula/descriptors/Morgan/combined PCA logistic; formula raw logistic and raw Morgan logistic/forest if the five-fold gate passes.
pooled_sensitivity.controls: 20 deterministic shuffled-label repetitions; leave-one-publication-out report; F1, precision, recall, balanced accuracy, AUROC and confusion counts; standardized formula weights; tree-specific OOB permutation is descriptive, not p-value.
